flexible_post_content.text_editor:
We believe in a collaborative community, and Agency Field Day is a day of fun and friendly competition that drives that value. We always have such a blast at Agency Field Day that we decided to bring it back this year on June 16th!

Last year, teams from O3 World, BlueCadet, Inverse Paradox, Slice Communications and Tonic Design Co. faced off in events.

This year, we are excited to have Blue Cadet and Inverse Paradox to join us again for another day of fun, and to have new team additions: Hanlon Creative and Seer Interactive.

Be sure to catch up on the action on June 16th by using the hashtag #PHLAgencyFieldDay via Instagram and Twitter.
